dct_description_sm: The main objective of the Arctic SOLAS programme was  to determine how variability in sea ice and water masses in the Arctic influences the ocean-ice-atmosphere exchanges of climate-active gases and particles and the chemical and radiative properties of the Arctic atmosphere. As part of this main programme, the 2008 N2O project aimed to determine the horizontal and vertical distribution of N2O in the eastern Canadian Arctic and evaluate the magnitude of the source and/or sink of this greenhouse gas in the region. The second main objective was to identify the mechanism responsible for N2O production in surface waters.
